notes.text: M. Savoie has not played this season. L. Draisaitl is in his usual spot beside C. McDavid and V. Podkolzin. That line is getting 12:18 a game at 5-on-5, up from 9:11 with Savoie.
K. Kapanen has started playing on the power play: on the ice for 56% of the team’s power-play time in 4 games, up from 6% last season.
